question: Should OpenClaw accept grouped Claw lifecycle management and this update-plan CLI/JSON contract as core experimental product surface?
rationale: Patch correctness does not settle acceptance of a new core lifecycle, public CLI command, machine-readable schema, and persisted ownership model under an open RFC and protected maintainer label.

options.title: Approve the stack direction
options.body: Approve the RFC direction, add the focused workspace-root regression guard, and land the base, planner, and apply slices in dependency order.

options.title: Revise before acceptance
options.body: Keep the drafts open while narrowing lifecycle ownership or changing the CLI and schema contract before it becomes a stack dependency.

options.title: Decline core lifecycle
options.body: Close the implementation stack if grouped Claw lifecycle management should not become OpenClaw core surface.

recommendation.title: Approve the stack direction
recommendation.body: Approve the RFC direction, add the focused workspace-root regression guard, and land the base, planner, and apply slices in dependency order.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest available owner signal for the shared state and central CLI boundaries affected by this product decision.
